text.en:
No. S 51

CHINESE MARRIAGE ENACTMENT, 1955 In exercise of the powers conferred on him by Section 3(1) of the Chinese Marriage Enactment Enactment 1955, His Highness the Sultan has been pleased to No.6 of 1955. appoint the Honourable Pehin Bendahari Kurnia DiRaja AWANG HONG KOK TIN to be Registrar of Chinese Marriages for Belait District. By COMMAND,

MARSAL MAUN Mentri Besar, Brunei. [Ref.: BRO. 646/54J
